orgStatus.description: The RedSky account configuration status for the organization.

companyId.description: The RedSky held token from the secret response.

redSkyOrgId.description: The RedSky organization ID for the organization which can be found in the RedSky portal.

adminExists.description: `true` if an Admin has been created in RedSky.

locationsStatus.description: Object that contains a list of locations and the `count` for the location list. Available if at least one location is exists.
